body:
* Improved Xray TUN is now the default tunnel provider and appears first in the provider pickers
* Improved ping tests are more reliable and no longer leave stray helper processes running
* Improved the Windows installer now ships fully signed binaries
* 
* Added a Reset action that repairs the background service on Windows, macOS and Linux, with its health checks included in the diagnostic report
* Added an editable system proxy exception list in Advanced settings
* Added Per-App Proxy support when running Xray TUN
* 
* Fixed encrypted subscriptions revealing their server details after the first refresh
* Fixed subscriptions failing to decrypt when delivered through a fronting proxy
* Fixed subscription links that redirect to a happ:// address not being added
* Fixed server configs that use the vcn alias for certificate verification not importing
* Fixed DNS going dead on Xray TUN
* Fixed proxy ping showing n/a on Xray TUN
* Fixed the buttons and AI Helper disappearing after deleting the last server from the list
* Fixed LAN sharing showing a virtual machine adapter address instead of the real local network one
* Fixed no error appearing when an invalid routing profile is imported in global routing settings
* Fixed the HTTP inbound toggle and user agent fields staying greyed out after a subscription lost premium
* Fixed the tunnel type from a subscription not being applied to free subscriptions
